_comment: Decisions Zach gave in issue comments that a body-only triage re-asked, recovered at real cost in hf7y/senechal#338. Standing policy, not history: follow them without re-asking. Lived in CLAUDE.md until 2026-08-25, when that file was deleted for drifting -- four of its factual CLAIMS were measured wrong in a single session. These are not claims about state, they are decisions, which is why they never drifted and why they are kept. Structured rather than prose so tools/standing-answers.py can surface them and check each one's issue is still closed. mechanism_paths is the checkable half: repo-relative files whose absence means nothing enforces the decision any more. Parsed from data, never from the prose in mechanism -- that parsing was itself a drift source.
_criterion: would an agent, not knowing this, re-ask Zach something he has already answered?

bashified-branch.decision: Abandoned as a branch, but its end goal stands: senechal moves into bashify logic, not shimmed scripts run from a clone. Do the migration; the branch is a means, not the decision.
bashified-branch.mechanism: health/bashified-ships-main.sh enforces that origin/main is an ancestor of origin/bashified

ssh-keys.decision: Remove ssh-office-nomac. ssh-id-ed25519 is accepted-with-planned-retirement (huge blast radius): leave it be, swap it for a scoped key opportunistically whenever it is noticed.

plasma-panel-visible.decision: Wire as-is, meaningful only from the user timer; INCOMPLETE, never a false PASS, when there is no display.

dexter-autologon.decision: Stale after the Zaxon fix. Delete the prose, add no speculation.

front-door-watch.decision: Retired. Zaxon lives on dexter/monkey; the real work is proving tailnet reachability from every agent host.

svc-vaporwave.decision: A host migration to dexter (its own VM, parallel to monkey), not a credential fix. realisateur's.

silence-audit-unmuted.decision: Unmuted 2026-08-15. The mute existed because silence-audit read scheduler's schedule/*.conf registry and mis-read it for every project; realisateur fixed exactly that (a3fe0a9, #308). Re-probed the same day: 110 mechanisms audited, 26 FLAGs, exit 0 -- not BLIND. Applies to whichever silence-audit row `discipline` prints.
silence-audit-unmuted.mechanism: MUTED-CHECKS.md carries the full record and the exact un-mute command

remedies-are-for-privileged-only.decision: senechal acts. Reversible operational fixes it does unattended, then reports. remedies/ is the narrower class that is genuinely Zach's: privileged or hard-to-undo changes. Filing an issue in place of an available fix is not a first move, and neither is leaving a finding 'for a human'.

concurrent-agents-here.decision: Other projects' tooling commits inside this repo while you may be mid-build, path-scoped so it leaves an unrelated dirty tree alone. Uncommitted work here that isn't yours: leave it, keep your own commit path-scoped, say so. Never `git add -A` in a repo you don't have full context for.

land-as-pr.decision: Land committed work as a PR, not a direct push -- origin/main can move mid-session and a plain push doesn't surface that, it just fails or races.
